commit.message:
fix(ci): bind exact PR SHA and restore the CLI crate root

Repair the three observed architecture-scope regressions without disabling
required gates. Select the preexisting byte-identical main.rs root for the
codex binary and retain repository isolation while including PR identity
and exact source SHA in required-workflow concurrency keys.

Preserve existing test scope and original source/experiment content;
record the source-head and synthetic-merge failures for native recheck.

-  group: blocking-ci::${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name || github.repository }}::${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref || github.ref_name }}
